skyabyss_record.title: The Stayer's Ledger
skyabyss_record.deny.inspect: Only operators can view another player's ledger
skyabyss_record.guard.no_toss: %s can't be thrown away. Store it in a chest or ender chest instead
skyabyss_record.guard.rescued: %s fell into the void and came back to you
skyabyss_record.guard.rescued_pending: %s fell into the void and is being held for you. You get it when you wake (or with /titanmemory claim)
skyabyss_record.guard.fragment_restored: The Sky Key Fragment you lost turns up again beside the heartbeat
skyabyss_record.d.pending_has: Rewards you couldn't take are being held.
skyabyss_record.d.pending_how: Claim with the button below or /titanmemory claim. They are also handed over when you wake or join. Anything that doesn't fit stays held.
skyabyss_record.d.kept: If you fall on a titan's back, your belongings and experience are kept and returned when you wake. Normally this is empty.
skyabyss_record.d.choice: Stilling the Stone Whale's heart for the first time lets you pick one of three exclusive legendaries. Until you pick, /titanmemory shows the choice again.
skyabyss_record.d.exchange: At the Resonance Forge, trade 30 of that titan's resonance fragments for an exclusive legendary you don't have. Once per heart. Used %s times so far.
skyabyss_record.d.place_bags: - In a bundle or box you carry x%s
skyabyss_record.d.place_ground_far: - On the ground x%s: %s %s, %s, %s (not loaded now)
skyabyss_record.d.guard_fragment: Protection: can't be thrown away (store it in a chest or ender chest). On the ground it never despawns, burns or breaks. If it falls into the void it comes back to you. You don't lose it when you fall on a titan's back.
skyabyss_record.d.guard_core: Protection: on the ground it never despawns, burns or breaks. If it falls into the void it comes back to you.
skyabyss_record.d.guard_call: Protection: on the ground it never despawns, burns or breaks. If it falls into the void it comes back to you.
skyabyss_record.d.guard_book: Protection: none needed. It comes back with the next entry.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_fragment: If lost: "Call back" returns the ones you no longer have. Stilling that titan's heart again also finds it by the heartbeat. Either way the old fragment crumbles to sand wherever it is found (one per person).
skyabyss_record.d.recover_core: If lost: each heart has a 25%% chance to drop another. It's a divine-gear material and is used to remake the whistle.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_call: If lost: craft it again from a bone, a Stone Whale Core and a Stone Whale Scale placed diagonally.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_book: If lost: the next time something is written, it returns to your pack if it's not in your inventory or ender chest.
skyabyss_record.d.memory: Counts heart clears that gave no new piece. At %s or more, collection gear chances double. At %s you are guaranteed a missing piece. Resets to 0 when the collection grows.
skyabyss_record.d.memory_next_guaranteed: The next heart guarantees a missing piece.
skyabyss_record.d.memory_next_soft: Doubled chances are on, or nearly on.
skyabyss_record.d.memory_next_plain: The pity is still far off.
skyabyss_record.d.clears: Goes up by one per heart. The exchange right also returns once per heart.
skyabyss_record.d.collection: Nine pieces: four shell armor parts, the greatsword, the charm and three exclusive legendaries. Counted once you've held one, even if you part with it later.
skyabyss_record.d.fragment_record: One per person. Survives trial resets.
skyabyss_record.d.exchanges: Times you used the forge exchange.
skyabyss_record.d.piece_chance: Heart drop chance: %s%% (with your current titan memory)
skyabyss_record.d.travel_unlocked: Titans whose heart you stilled come when you blow their whistle. For travel between places on the surface, not for entering the back.
skyabyss_record.d.cooldown: Time until you can call a titan again.
skyabyss_record.d.xp: Experience in this level and what the next level needs.
skyabyss_record.d.points: %s points per level, up to %s per stat. Spend them on the J screen.
skyabyss_record.d.skill_points: One at Lv 1 and at every odd level. Spend them on the K screen.
skyabyss_record.d.respecs: Respecs at the Resonance Forge. The first is free; later ones cost resonance crystals.
skyabyss_record.d.quest_missing: This quest's definition is missing (a datapack was removed?).
skyabyss_record.d.quests_none: Talk to a village storyteller to begin.
skyabyss_record.d.affinity: Affinity ranges %s to %s. Talking raises it a little.
skyabyss_record.d.lore_total: Written by reading carvings and torn pages, witnessing events and listening.
skyabyss_record.d.loop: Times the moon fell and time rewound (shared by the whole server).
skyabyss_record.d.quest_tracked: Tracked on the left of the screen.
skyabyss_record.d.fragments_became_key: The four fragments became one sky key.
skyabyss_record.d.fragments_missing: Lost fragments: %s. "Call back" below returns them to you.
skyabyss_record.d.bond_fragment: Bond: a fragment is bound to the one who received it. In someone else's hands it goes home to its owner. Put in a chest, its place is noted when you close the chest.
skyabyss_record.d.fragment_got: You stilled the heart of the %s and received its fragment.
skyabyss_record.d.fragment_how: Still the heart of the %s to receive one.
skyabyss_record.d.fragment_hidden: A fragment of an unseen titan. Still the previous titan's heart to learn its name.
skyabyss_record.d.guard_key: Protection: can't be thrown away. On the ground it never despawns or burns, and it comes back from the void. It is bound to its owner and returns if someone else takes it.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_key: If lost: "Call back" returns it to you. The old key crumbles to sand wherever it is found.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_core_other: If lost: it may drop again each time you still that titan's heart.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_call_stone_wha: If lost: craft it again from bone, a stone whale core and a stone whale scale placed diagonally.
skyabyss_record.d.recover_call_tide_shel: If lost: craft it again from a nautilus shell, a tide shell flake and a heart of the sea in a column.
skyabyss_record.d.choice_other: A reward you choose the first time you still the heart of the %s.
skyabyss_record.d.place_stash_far: - In a chest x%s: %s %s, %s, %s (not loaded now)
skyabyss_record.d.stage: Titan hearts stilled in order. Only those who stilled the previous heart themselves can board the next titan.
skyabyss_record.d.titan_stopped: You stilled the heart of the %s.
skyabyss_record.d.titan_not_risen: The %s has not yet shown itself in this world.
skyabyss_record.d.titan_challenge: You may challenge the %s. Board its back and find the heart.
skyabyss_record.d.titan_unseen: Still the previous titan's heart to learn its name and where it is rumoured to be.
skyabyss_record.d.page_hidden: An unseen titan. This page opens once you still the previous titan's heart yourself.
skyabyss_record.d.page_not_risen: Written here once this titan appears.
skyabyss_record.d.collection_other: %s pieces of this titan's gear. Counted once you have held them (even if you part with them later).
skyabyss_record.d.travel_stone_whale: Still the stone whale's heart to receive its call. Blow it under open sky and it carries you above the clouds.
skyabyss_record.d.travel_tide_shell: Still the tide shell's heart to receive its conch. Blow it at the shore and the titan comes into the shallows and carries you across the sea to a beach.
skyabyss_record.d.collection_none: This titan's gear has not been made yet.
skyabyss_record.bond.crumbled: The husk of a called-back %s crumbled to sand
skyabyss_record.bond.went_home: The %s grew cold in your hand and went home to %s
skyabyss_record.bond.heart_restored: A sky key fragment you had lost turned up again by the heartbeat (%s)
skyabyss_record.bond.nothing_missing_fra: Every fragment's place is known. Check the ledger to see where
skyabyss_record.bond.nothing_missing_key: The sky key's place is known. Check the ledger
skyabyss_record.bond.recalled_fragment: Answering the call, your lost fragments returned to you (%s)
skyabyss_record.bond.recalled_key: Answering the call, the sky key returned to you
skyabyss_record.d.readiness: How ready your body, blade and stores are for %s's heart. Green is enough, yellow nearly, red short (also by shape: round green, triangle yellow, square red). Measured against that titan's benchmark.
skyabyss_record.d.readiness_free: Red never stops you from boarding or fighting. You are asked once when boarding.
skyabyss_record.d.steles: The stones after each trial. The value reads "rung by you / rung by the party / not yet". When anyone in the party rings one, it counts as cleared for everyone.
skyabyss_record.d.steles_none: This titan has no stones to ring.
